description.narrative: The Somalia Multi-Partner Trust Fund, founded on Busan New Deal principles, supports joint programmes that address priorities in line with Somalia’s Peacebuilding and Statebuilding Goals. Because reconciliation and conflict resolution are fundamental to Somalia’s state-building process, Fund programmes focus on immediate delivery, building local resilience, and capacity development.
